name.en-US: The Way of the Cross: Its Efficacy and Practice
name.pt-BR: A Via-Sacra: sua eficácia e prática

description.en-US: A short treatise on the devotion of the Stations of the Cross, with a meditation on each of the fourteen stations. Extracted from Christ in His Mysteries (conference XIV), it appeared in 1923 almost at the abbot’s death; he said the Way of the Cross every day. English only: no open French text exists.
description.pt-BR: Breve tratado sobre a devoção da Via-Sacra, com uma meditação sobre cada uma das catorze estações. Extraído de «Le Christ dans ses mystères» (conferência XIV), apareceu em 1923, quase na morte do abade, que a rezava todos os dias.

sources.edition: The Way of the Cross, its Efficacy and Practice, Edinburgh/London: Sands, 1923 (imprimatur Edinburgh 9 May 1923). Internet Archive scan, OCR text.
sources.description: Translator’s note, foreword, the treatise and the fourteen stations. The edition omits the scripture-reference footnotes. The French (Maredsous, 1923) has no open text.
sources.tierEvidence: Anonymous translation published 1923: public domain in the US (before 1931) and, as an anonymous work, in Brazil and the EU.

title.en-US: The Efficacy of the Way of the Cross
The Exercise of the Way of the Cross
I. Jesus is condemned to death by Pilate
II. Jesus is laden with His Cross
III. Jesus falls the first time under the weight of His Cross
IV. Jesus meets His Holy Mother
V. Simon the Cyrenean helps Jesus to carry His Cross
VI. A woman wipes the face of Jesus
VII. Jesus falls the second time
VIII. Jesus speaks to the women of Jerusalem
IX. Jesus falls for the third time
X. Jesus is stripped of His garments
XI. Jesus is nailed to the Cross
XII. Jesus dies upon the Cross
XIII. The body of Jesus is taken down from the Cross
XIV. Jesus is laid in the Sepulchre
